headline: The Forge learns when the Mac sleeps
lede: Oct 31 the Studio was put to sleep by hand at 00:17 and nothing noticed for 11 hours. The warden now keeps a power-outage ledger itself — and says so on the pulse, the board, and the questions digest.

notes.text: #1354 shipped: a ≥30-min gap between warden ticks becomes a named window from pmset history — reason, span, dark-wake count (the real Oct 31 night replays as 00:17–11:35, Software Sleep, 77 naps).
/forge now opens with a red banner when the machine was down: STUDIO WAS ASLEEP HH:MM–HH:MM · 11h 18m · 77 dark wakes — a sleeping Mac finally reads differently from a lazy fleet.
The questions digest leads with the sleep sentence too, so it reaches Jon's inbox without opening the board; keeping the shared Mac awake stays his call.

sleepwatchcheck: 96 gates incl. verbatim pmset grammar and the real incident; flipping the threshold reddens 7 and back. Follow-up #1392 files the honest v1 gap: dark-wake churn that never misses a tick.
